facts.fact: Acclime reports that the Data Protection Act 2017 is applied by the Data Protection Office in guidance issued in September 2026.
Acclime reports the Data Protection Office and its Commissioner took registrations and issued guidance in September 2026.
Acclime cites the Data Protection (Designation, Tasks and Position of Data Protection Officers) Regulations 2026 and the Data Protection (Fees) Regulations 2020 under the Act.
Acclime reports guidance requiring Management Companies to register and appoint Data Protection Officers, with no named decision.
